• Neurological Context

Integrations:

• Neurology
• Orthopedics
• Rheumatology
• Physical Therapy
• Occupational Therapy
• Speech Therapy
• Prosthetics and Orthotics
• Psychology
• Social Care

HIGH

Status:
Documentation

---
reviews.verdict: Preserve baseline function, patient-defined goals, participation/accessibility, developmental context, therapy dose and outcome measures, assistive-device fit/maintenance, school/home context and adult handover. Functional independence and quality of life are separate from impairment scores; home programs, swallowing/feeding and return-to-activity require clinician review.

HIGH

Documentation
